overview: Uruguay is a small country in south-eastern South America, between Argentina and Brazil. Its capital and largest city is Montevideo, home to about four in ten Uruguayans. Uruguay declared independence in 1825. It hosted and won the first football World Cup, in 1930.

geography.text: Uruguay is mostly low, rolling grassland, used for raising cattle and sheep. It has a long coast on the wide Río de la Plata estuary and the Atlantic Ocean, with beach resorts such as Punta del Este. The Uruguay River forms its border with Argentina.
